title: What Is Additional Matching?

## What Is Additional Matching?
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000007993
Additional Matching allows directory owners to manually send a lead to additional members after the lead has been submitted.
This feature can be used with leads generated from both Member Contact Forms and Get Matched Forms, providing greater flexibility when connecting visitors with relevant businesses or professionals.
With the Basic Lead package included in every Brilliant Directories license, administrators can manually match leads to additional members within the directory.
Manual matching provides complete control over which members receive a lead, making it a reliable option for directories that require accuracy and oversight when distributing inquiries.
